description: An index with a heredoc key in a JSON string makes static traversal analysis an error
notes: The spec reads the string as a native syntax expression and delegates to its static traversal analysis, where an index whose key is a heredoc without interpolations is an index step, as in native/analysis/traversal-index-heredoc. hashicorp/hcl parses the string with hclsyntax.ParseTraversalAbs instead of as an expression (expression.AsTraversal in json/structure.go), and that parser only accepts a number or a quoted string between index brackets (parseTraversal in hclsyntax/parser_traversal.go).
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
